**QA Probe Generation: A Structured Approach**

Okay, so the task is clear: I need to craft Question-Answering (QA) probes for two "knowledge cards," one target and one neighbor, in a JSON format. The goal is to generate one core and three surface questions for each card. Let's see how I approached this.

First, I examined the target card. It describes the "2025 Catatumbo clashes" and the "involved\_group" relation, with the fact that "FARC dissidents were targeted by attacks." From this, I naturally formulated a core question: "Which group was targeted by attacks during the 2025 Catatumbo clashes?" I also considered the aliases, "FARC-EP dissidents," to use as potential answers to the question. Then, I brainstormed several surface questions that rephrased this core idea, focusing on different phrasings that ask essentially the same thing: "Who was on the receiving end of the attacks?", "What specific faction was targeted?", and "Which armed group was the target of the attacks?"

Next, I turned my attention to the neighbor card. This card concerns the "2025 Ecuadorian general election" and the "involved\_group" relation, with the fact that "The RETO Movement formed a left-leaning bloc with the Citizen Revolution Movement." I crafted a core question for this card: "Which group formed a left-leaning bloc with the Citizen Revolution Movement in the 2025 Ecuadorian general election?" The answer would be the "RETO Movement", which had the alias "RETO". Again, I fleshed out surface questions, varying the wording: "What movement partnered with the Citizen Revolution Movement?", "Which organization joined forces with the Citizen Revolution Movement?", and "What other group was part of the left-leaning bloc?".

After drafting the questions, I performed a thorough review of the generated probes to ensure adherence to all requirements. I confirmed that I had exactly one core question and three surface questions per card, that the questions all pertained to the original fact, and that the questions "backwards" from the answer. Importantly, I ensured that no information from the correct answer was leaked. The original relation was maintained, and I confirmed that all questions were in English and that the output would adhere to valid JSON formatting. Now, I will put it all together.
